Class ConfigKey<T>

java.lang.Object
fr.robie.machineengine.api.config.ConfigKey<T>
public final class ConfigKey<T> extends Object
One setting of a ConfigFile: its path (limits.max-machines-per-chunk), its type, its default, the comment written above it, and whether a reload may change it.

Keys are immutable: comment and restartOnly return a new key. Declare them as constants and read them with ConfigValues.get(ConfigKey).
